# plan:nav-dev-beside-prod — evidence (coder/dev-beside-prod, pij-professional-crane)

Worktree /Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-dev-beside-prod, branch dev-beside-prod.
Ports: prod 3104 (+ sidecar 4604), dev 3114 (+ 4614). Jordan's :3000 untouched.

## Before (origin/main 0aebeb1a5)
- One file, `.chainglass/server.json`, written by whichever server booted last and deleted by whichever
  exits first (instrumentation.ts:118-157). Main tree at 10:08: one entry, port 3000 pid 26768.
- `just preflight` read `apps/web/.chainglass/server.json`, a path the server never writes since
  Plan 084 Phase 5, so it always reported "Dev server not running".
- origin/main `prod-serve` against a live listener (python http.server on 3124), load ~90:
  "⚠️ Port 3124 already in use by PID 80732 (...http.server 3124...) / Killing stale process..." then
  Next took the port ("Ready in 950ms").
- Prod served `apps/web/.next`; any `next build` (fft, just build, and `just dev` itself — turbo runs
  @chainglass/web:build as a ^build dependency when dev starts) rewrote it under the live server
  (prime's incident: blank pages, chunks 500).

## After
- Prod refuses, before building, with prod live on 3104 (11:21, load ~90):
  `PORT=3104 just prod` → "❌ Port 3104 in use by PID 91696 (next-server) / ❌ Port 4604 ... /
  Not killing a live server ... KILL_EXISTING=1 just prod", exit 1; 3104 kept serving (200).
- Prod serves its own copy: relocated build on 3104 served 5/5 chunks 200 with apps/web/.next moved
  away (10:43). Then `just build` (new BUILD_ID mjn-AA4S... in .next) while that prod served the old
  copy (XmMElIS...): 22/22 chunks 200, /login 200 (11:20). Then `just dev` on 3114 ran its own
  web:build (.next → E6iGMG...) while prod served mjn-AA4S... from .next-prod-3104: 18/18 chunks 200,
  /login 200 (11:29, load ~229).
- `KILL_EXISTING=1 PORT=3104 just prod` (11:21:39): turbo build, stage clone, kill old, swap, "Ready in
  136ms"; entry `.chainglass/servers/3104.json` {port 3104, mode prod}.
- Both together, discoverable (11:25 load ~105; re-run 11:29 with TMUX unset +
  TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/dev-beside-prod-tmux, load ~243):
  just preflight → "✓ prod server running (port 3104 ...) ✓ dev server running (port 3114 ...)
  ✓ CLI targets port 3104 (set CG_SERVER_PORT to pick another)".
  `cg remote-view list` → [] (prod); `CG_SERVER_PORT=3114 cg remote-view list` → [] (dev);
  `CG_SERVER_PORT=3999` → "no running chainglass server found".
  `CG_SERVER_PORT=3114 cg wf stop no-such-flow` → {"ok":true,"stopped":false} from dev;
  `CG_SERVER_PORT=3999 cg wf stop` → "Chainglass server not running (no live .chainglass/servers/3999.json found)".
  Token isolation: dev+prodToken 401, dev+devToken 200, prod+devToken 401, prod+prodToken 200.
- Stage copy: rsync of the build (140 MB) took 5 m 9 s under load; `cp -c` APFS clone 2.1 s → recipe uses cp -c.
